description: Circle of Spores Druids harness the power of decay and symbiosis, merging with fungal symbionts for power.

features.name: Symbiotic Entity
features.description: As a bonus action, you can summon a fungal symbiont that grants temporary hit points and lets you use unarmed strikes as magical.

features.name: Spore Burst
features.description: When a creature moves within 10 feet of you while your symbiont is active, you can spend a reaction to force a saving throw or it takes poison damage.

features.name: Plague Carrier
features.description: Your symbiont grants resistance to disease and poison, and allies within 10 feet gain the same.

features.name: Sporeling Network
features.description: You can sense the presence of creatures within 30 feet through your spore network.
